name: Dynamic Particle Distribution
aliases: Dynamic Particle Distribution — Particle Distribution on Isosurface
Dynamic Particle Isosurface Sampling with Contraction Correction
definition: A method to distribute particles on an isosurface by projecting them onto the implicit function and moving them based on inter-particle forces scaled by the sizing field h.
summary: Dynamic Particle Distribution is a particle-based sampling method that refines initial vertices into a uniformly distributed point cloud by using inter-particle forces to adapt density to local curvature, unlike fixed-topology methods.
